name: models3d_animate
description: Apply a Meshy catalog animation, or a `models3d_motion_generate` clip, to a `models3d_rig` (provider meshy) rigged model.

actionId.description: Meshy animation catalog action id. Default 1. Exclusive with motionIdentifier.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

motionIdentifier.description: Clip from `models3d_motion_generate`, applied instead of a catalog action. Expires after 3 days.

operationType.description: change_fps (default): the animated model. fbx2usdz: USDZ for AR. extract_armature: the skeleton alone.
